verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show CloudConvert offering its own way to define event-triggered rules or automations. Jobs chain tasks such as S3 import, convert and export, but each job is started by an API call, not by an event rule. Zapier workflows are defined in a third-party tool, the Socket API and SDKs are developer building blocks, and credit auto-refill is an adjacent billing feature. None of these earn credit for this story.
